comments.text: Without watching the video i can confidently say no it wont. Colonialism nay have kept the continent down for centuries but thats not why theyre so underdeveloped... just look at the rate of corruption among their people in power

replies.author: @nuusain996
replies.text: ‘It’s not colonialism, it’s the corrupt leaders’ ... as if independence magically dismantled the colonial state, borders, patronage networks and foreign interests that keep those leaders in place. You found the post-colonial mechanism and somehow thought it disproved the colonial cause.
